feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: NPR world news, international art and culture, world business and financial markets, world economy, and global trends in health, science and technology. Subscribe to the World Story of the Day podcast and RSS feed.

entry.title: Trump asks SCOTUS to OK changes to mail-in ballots. And, diesel prices hit record high
entry.summary: Trump has asked the Supreme Court to lift the block on his plan for the USPS to restrict mail voting ahead of the midterm elections. And, diesel prices have reached a record high.

entry.title: Germany's far-right AfD party is poised for power in a state election
entry.summary: Germany's AfD's TikTok-fueled rise in Saxony-Anhalt is raising fears the country could see its first far-right governor since World War II.

entry.title: Russia intensifies attacks on Ukraine's capital
entry.summary: In Ukraine, a week of near-continuous Russian attacks is upending the lives of residents in Kyiv and its suburbs.

entry.title: Argentina's Milei escalates Falklands dispute, seizing on Trump comments and oil tensions
entry.summary: Argentine President Javier Milei is escalating a dispute with Britain over the Falkland Islands with tougher sanctions targeting companies involved in a major offshore oil project

entry.title: 2 trapped workers rescued from a hydropower tunnel 9 days after Nepal floods
entry.summary: Officials say rescuers in Nepal have pulled two workers alive from a tunnel Friday during an ongoing operation. The rescues come nine days after the Aug. 26 floods.

entry.title: As El Niño intensifies, Rio turns to science — and a spiritual adviser
entry.summary: This year's Super El Niño has brought unprecedented weather to Rio de Janeiro. Unaccustomed to tornado-strength winds, the city found an unusual partner to combat the weather: a spiritual adviser.

entry.title: Nepali community in Texas grieves and prays for healing after flash floods
entry.summary: Nepalese groups in North Texas, which has one of the largest communities of people from Nepal in the U.S., continue to grieve the loss of hundreds of people after the devastating floods in August.

entry.title: Dems demand DHS fund election security. And, journalist Gloria Steinem has died
entry.summary: Two Democrats are demanding that Homeland Security officials fund election security ahead of the midterms. And, trail-blazing journalist Gloria Steinem has died.

entry.title: Families of the missing in Nepal's flash floods perform symbolic cremations
entry.summary: Eight days after Nepal's flash floods, families who can't find loved ones perform symbolic cremations.

entry.title: China's Xi visits Egypt for the first time in a decade
entry.summary: Xi Jinping's visit to Egypt for the first time in a decade, and during the Iran war, comes as U.S. allies broaden their security ties.
